text.title: FreshDrop team, 3 families observed at home, Moscow, August 2026
text.hypothesis: at home the family plans the order on the phone during dinner prep and loses the slot when they forget
text.setting: 3 homes, 2 visits each, 1.5 hours per visit
text.role: passive, with clarifying questions; partial immersion
text.patterns: all 3 families plan on the phone during cooking; 2 of 3 check the slot after work
text.refuted: the family does not compare prices; they choose by habit
text.decision: build the reminder into the cooking time; test with 10 families
text.f1: Tue 19:10: opened the app, typed «milk», gave up on the slot
text.f2: Tue 19:40: called the shop, ordered by phone
text.f3: Wed 07:30: checked the slot on the way to work
text.q1: «I just want it to come when I am home»
text.q2: «The slot is always gone by the evening»
text.i1: the family plans around the slot, not the price
text.i2: the phone is the planning tool at dinner prep
text.i3: missed slots push the family back to the shop
